verification_phase: Phase 2 — TC-08 Static Threshold & Parameter Binding Verification

framework_stream_audit.sql_statement:
SELECT 
    id,
    session_id,
    stream_type,
    content,
    metadata,
    ROUND((1 - (embedding <=> $1::vector))::numeric, 4) AS similarity
FROM knowledge_vault
WHERE stream_type = 'framework'
  AND 1 - (embedding <=> $1::vector) >= 0.70
ORDER BY (embedding <=> $1::vector) ASC
LIMIT 2;
